title: Normal Noetherian family approximation with pointed generic-fibre limits
statement: Let S be a qcqs integral scheme with integrally closed stalks, c:C→S a qcqs smooth morphism with geometrically connected fibres, and σ a section. Let n be a natural number whose image in Γ(S,O_S) is a unit. Let q:Cη→Spec k(S), j:Cη→C be the generic-fibre pullback, and let sη:Spec k(S)→Cη satisfy sηq=1 and sηj=iσ. There exist a small cofiltered category I, diagrams D,K:I→Scheme, limit cones κ:Cη→D and b:Spec k(S)→K, and a natural transformation s:K→D such that sηκ_i=b_i s_i for every i. Both diagrams have qcqs objects and affine transition maps. For each i there are normal integral Noetherian qcqs S_i, a qcqs smooth geometrically connected family c_i:C_i→S_i, its section σ_i, maps q_i:D_i→Spec k(S_i), j_i:D_i→C_i giving its generic-fibre pullback, an isomorphism e_i:K_i≅Spec k(S_i), and a comparison a_i:C→C_i. The number n is invertible on every S_i. The section e_i^{-1}s_i of q_i is compatible with σ_i: e_i^{-1}s_i q_i=1 and e_i^{-1}s_i j_i=i_i σ_i. The comparisons obey κ_i j_i=j a_i. This statement concerns only the family and its pointed generic fibres, with no finite torsor or extension of a cover.

proof.text: Apply exists_normal_pointed_family_approximation to obtain a normal Noetherian cartesian system of families, their limiting cones, compatible sections, and stagewise invertibility of n. Use Noetherian compactness for the base objects.

Apply exists_cartesian_family_generic_limit to this system and to the supplied generic-fibre square. It provides generic-fibre and generic-base diagrams with limits, actual pullback projections, and the generic-point identifications.

At every stage lift the identity on K_i and t_i τ_i into its generic-fibre pullback. The section equation τ_i p_i=1 makes this lift well-defined. Pullback hom_ext and naturality of t, τ, r and δ show these lifts form s:K→D. Test the given generic section compatibility with r_i and δ_i; the supplied equations sη q=1, sη j=ι σ and the two comparison cone equations prove both tests. Thus sη κ_i=b_i s_i.

Set S₀(i)=X_i, C₀(i)=Y_i, c₀(i)=p_i, σ₀(i)=τ_i, q₀(i)=r_i e_i, j₀(i)=δ_i, and a(i)=γ_i. Transport each generic-fibre pullback along e_i using IsPullback.of_iso. The two section equations follow from the lift projection equations and e_i^{-1}e_i=1. All family properties come directly from the descended system, and κ_i j₀(i)=j a(i) is the generic comparison equation. Assemble these witnesses.

theorem exists_normal_family_generic_limit {S C : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace S]
    [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] [IsIntegral S]
    (hS : ∀ x : S, IsIntegrallyClosed (S.presheaf.stalk x))
    (c : C ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact c] [QuasiSeparated c] [Smooth c] [GeometricallyConnected c]
    (σ : S ⟶ C) (hσ : σ ≫ c = 𝟙 S) (n : ℕ) (hn : IsUnit (n : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    {Cη : Scheme.{u}} (q : Cη ⟶ Spec S.functionField) (j : Cη ⟶ C)
    (hCη : IsPullback q j (S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S)) c)
    (sη : Spec S.functionField ⟶ Cη) (hsq : sη ≫ q = 𝟙 _)
    (hsj : sη ≫ j = S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S) ≫ σ) :
    ∃ (I : Type u) (hcat : SmallCategory I),
      letI : SmallCategory I := hcat
      ∃ (hco : IsCofiltered I) (D K : I ⥤ Scheme.{u})
        (κ : (Functor.const I).obj Cη ⟶ D)
        (b : (Functor.const I).obj (Spec S.functionField) ⟶ K) (s : K ⟶ D),
        ∃ (hκ : IsLimit (Cone.mk Cη κ))
          (hb : IsLimit (Cone.mk (Spec S.functionField) b)),
        (∀ i, CompactSpace (D.obj i)) ∧ (∀ i, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)) ∧
        (∀ i, CompactSpace (K.obj i)) ∧ (∀ i, QuasiSeparatedSpace (K.obj i)) ∧
        (∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)) ∧
        (∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (K.map f)) ∧
        (∀ i, sη ≫ κ.app i = b.app i ≫ s.app i) ∧
        ∃ (S₀ C₀ : I → Scheme.{u}) (hI₀ : ∀ i, IsIntegral (S₀ i)),
          letI : ∀ i, IsIntegral (S₀ i) := hI₀
          ∃ (c₀ : ∀ i, C₀ i ⟶ S₀ i) (σ₀ : ∀ i, S₀ i ⟶ C₀ i)
            (q₀ : ∀ i, D.obj i ⟶ Spec (S₀ i).functionField)
            (j₀ : ∀ i, D.obj i ⟶ C₀ i)
            (e : ∀ i, K.obj i ≅ Spec (S₀ i).functionField) (a : ∀ i, C ⟶ C₀ i),
            ∀ i, IsNoetherian (S₀ i) ∧ QuasiSeparatedSpace (S₀ i) ∧
              (∀ x : S₀ i, IsIntegrallyClosed ((S₀ i).presheaf.stalk x)) ∧
              QuasiCompact (c₀ i) ∧ QuasiSeparated (c₀ i) ∧ Smooth (c₀ i) ∧
              GeometricallyConnected (c₀ i) ∧ σ₀ i ≫ c₀ i = 𝟙 (S₀ i) ∧
              IsUnit (n : Γ(S₀ i, ⊤)) ∧
              IsPullback (q₀ i) (j₀ i) ((S₀ i).fromSpecStalk (genericPoint (S₀ i)))
                (c₀ i) ∧
              (e i).inv ≫ s.app i ≫ q₀ i = 𝟙 _ ∧
              (e i).inv ≫ s.app i ≫ j₀ i =
                (S₀ i).fromSpecStalk (genericPoint (S₀ i)) ≫ σ₀ i ∧
              κ.app i ≫ j₀ i = j ≫ a i
